subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “The old broadcast made them understand that every generation has its own 'new media.'”?
options: Some small objects help people rest because they hold a quiet world that does not hurry.
The old swing reminded everyone that a place can change without losing its story.
People still need to ask why it keeps becoming full and what should change.
What feels old now was once powerful enough to change how people imagined the world.
